title: A cleaning visit
hook: Compare the effects on both participants.

knows: Ecological interactions can affect participants differently.
doesNotKnow: Both fish benefit in this stipulated interaction, so it is mutualistic. Actual interactions can vary among species and situations.

misconception: An interaction must affect both participants in the same way.
objective: Classify the stated effects of an ecological interaction.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: A cleaner fish obtains food by removing parasites, and in this example the host fish benefits from parasite removal. Using + for benefit, − for harm and 0 for no appreciable effect, which signs describe Cleaner fish and Host fish, in that order? Cleaner fish: +; Host fish: +. Both fish benefit in this stipulated interaction, so it is mutualistic. Actual interactions can vary among species and situations.
claims.source: Stipulated simplified example; ecological definitions: OpenStax https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/45-6-community-ecology

claims.text: Icons and signs summarize the stipulated interaction and do not quantify fitness or capture every ecological effect.

Recall: What term describes the Cleaner fish–Host fish interaction as stated in the lesson? Both fish benefit in this stipulated interaction, so it is mutualistic. Actual interactions can vary among species and situations.
